candidates.reason: Central TLS context-factory tests. They already carry version gates and filters for Twisted (TWISTED_TLS_NEW_IMPL) and pyOpenSSL (PYOPENSSL_SET_CIPHER_LIST_TMP_CONN) deprecations, so new warnings from the VCS dependency branches (Twisted, pyOpenSSL, cryptography) surface here first.

Shared HTTPS download-handler base driving every concrete handler; it holds the pyOpenSSL X.509 deprecation filter and the TWISTED_TLS_LIMITS_OFFBY1 gate, making it the shared place where TLS-path warnings are handled.
Concrete Twisted HTTP/1.1 TLS handler matrix, the most likely place for warnings emitted by the Twisted and pyOpenSSL development branches to show up.
Concrete Twisted HTTP/2 TLS handler matrix using the same certificate and context-factory code paths as HTTP/1.1, so the same VCS dependency warning sources apply.
httpx2 is replaced by its development branch in the VCS workflow, and this module exercises its TLS, certificate-verification, proxy and warning behavior.
Shared mock-server TLS setup chooses between cryptography and the deprecated pyOpenSSL certificate APIs based on dependency versions, so its warnings propagate into every HTTPS handler test.
Exercises end-to-end HTTPS certificate handling and already filters the pyOpenSSL X.509 deprecation emitted while cryptography/pyOpenSSL run their development branches.
Reads and compares peer certificates through Twisted/pyOpenSSL and already filters the X.509 deprecation, a path that changes when the VCS branches of those dependencies are installed.
Shared response base that is version-gated on w3lib URL normalization behavior (W3LIB_STRIPS_URLS), a dependency replaced by its development branch in the VCS workflow.
Concrete consumer of the w3lib-gated response base, so behavior and warning differences from the w3lib development branch appear in its assertions.
Uses the version-gated stdlib robotparser behavior (STDLIB_IMPROVED_ROBOTFILEPARSER) and the Protego development branch, both dependency-sensitive in the VCS workflow.

Directly tests asyncio event-loop handling and Twisted reactor installation, where Python 3.14 and Twisted development-branch deprecations (the twisted#12527 workaround in scrapy/utils/reactor.py) appear.
Async crawler runner/process tests install and exercise the asyncio reactor, another location where event-loop deprecation warnings surface under the VCS workflow.
Contains a direct asyncio.get_event_loop() call and exercises pipeline-to-asyncio bridging, which emits event-loop deprecation warnings on newer Python and Twisted versions.
